bio.text: Andy Harris has represented Maryland's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House since he was first elected in 2010.
Born in Brooklyn in 1957, he studied medicine at Johns Hopkins and practiced as an anesthesiologist there for nearly three decades.
Harris served in the Naval Reserve as a medical officer, reaching the rank of Commander, and was a member of the Maryland State Senate for 12 years starting in 1998.
He lives in Dorchester County, Maryland.
